# EverywherePoster app workspace instructions

When this directory is opened as a separate workspace, retain the enclosing repository's [Copilot guidance](../../.github/copilot-instructions.md) and [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md). Follow their scope, verification, and approval rules.

Use [app coding conventions](../CLAUDE.md), the toolchain declared in [package.json](../package.json), and [focused tests](../tests/README.md). Read the repository [operating manual](../../OPERATING-MANUAL.md) before runtime, database, environment, or deployment work.

This adapter adds no independent setup, database, telemetry, model, or release policy.
